about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.

mutants.name: stdsh-trimleft-binding
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 10: TrimLeft binds Go's TrimLeft (law TrimLeftRightKeepEnds).

mutants.name: stdsh-builder-write
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 10: a Builder's text is its writes in order (law BuilderConcatenates).

mutants.name: stdsh-max-binding
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cmp: Max is the larger value (law MaxMinSplit).

mutants.name: bn1-ties-untied
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 3: tied sizes share their mid-rank (law MatchesEnumeration).

mutants.name: bn1-zeros-kept
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 3: the signed-rank test drops zero differences (law MatchesEnumeration).

mutants.name: bn1-walsh-index
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 4: the interval is [W(c), W(m-1-c)] (laws IntervalCoverageIsExact, Mirror).

mutants.name: bn1-look-95
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 5: a planned look judges at Pocock's 98.42% (law PlannedLevelIsPocock).

mutants.name: bn1-holm-unsorted
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: Holm steps down over the p-values in ascending order (law HolmRejectsNoMore).

mutants.name: bn1-bound-on-ratio
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, A symmetric bound: the bound is symmetric in log space, so swapping the sides mirrors the verdict (law Mirror).

mutants.name: bn1-five-pairs
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 6: fewer than 6 pairs never decide (law FewPairsNeverDecide).

mutants.name: bn1-exact-moved
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 8: an exact counter that moves is refused CounterUnstable (law ExactIsExact).

mutants.name: bn1-bound-absolute
mutants.from: f * if b >= h { b } else { h }
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 7: on the difference scale the bound is b times the larger median, so no verdict depends on the unit (law ScaleFree).

mutants.name: bn1-zero-interval-unclear
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 7: a change claim whose interval is exactly [0, 0] is Same (law AllEqualIsSame).

mutants.name: bn1-center-midrange
mutants.from: let center = if m%2 == 1 { w[m/2] } else { (w[m/2-1] + w[m/2]) / 2.0 }
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 4: the estimate is the median of the Walsh averages (law IntervalHoldsEstimate).

mutants.name: bn1-coverage-half
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 4: the interval covers 1 - 2 P(T <= c) (law IntervalCoverageIsExact).

mutants.name: bn1-noworse-reads-center
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 7: NoWorse needs the whole interval below the margin (law NoWorseReadsTheInterval).

mutants.name: bn1-holm-uncorrected
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: Holm divides alpha by the p-values left (law HolmRejectsNoMore).

mutants.name: bn2-base-first-always
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 2: pairs run base first and head first in turn (law AlternatesOrder).

mutants.name: bn2-look-each-pair
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 5: a series is judged only at the design's looks (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-warmup-kept
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 2: one warm block of each side is discarded (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-refusal-as-zero
mutants.from:
case (Lost as l, _):
			words[i] = Some[Verdict]{Value: Refused{Why: l.Why}}
mutants.to:
case (Lost as l, _):
			pairs[i] = pairs[i].Append(Pair{Base: 0.0, Head: if l.Why == NoMetric { 0.0 } else { 0.0 }})
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Verdicts and refusals: a refusal carries no number and is never read as 0 (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-secondary-ungated
mutants.from: if words[i] != None || i > 0 && words[0] == None {
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: secondaries get a verdict only after the primary has one (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-verdict-retaken
mutants.from: if words[i] != None || i > 0 && words[0] == None {
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 5: a decided series keeps its look's verdict (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-run-incomplete-kept
mutants.from:
case (Got, Lost as l):
			words[i] = Some[Verdict]{Value: Refused{Why: l.Why}}
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Verdicts and refusals: a block that lost a counter refuses its series (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-stop-on-any-word
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: the run goes on for the secondaries after the primary decides (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-step-takes-any-block
mutants.rule: the Referee machine rejects a signal for a block it did not ask for (law MachineIsJudge).

mutants.name: bn2-futility-at-80
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 10: the futility stop reads the 50% projection (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-futility-never
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 10: a planned series that needs more pairs than its last look is Underpowered (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-holm-skipped
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 9: Holm's step-down at 5% over the secondaries (law SecondariesAreOneFamily).

mutants.name: bn2-fixed-unbounded
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Method 6: a design past MaxPairs is refused before any block (law MatchesReference).

mutants.name: bn2-meter-drops-last
mutants.rule: Meter.ReadsEverySeries: a meter answers every series (law Meter.ReadsEverySeries).

mutants.name: bn2-warm-unmarked
mutants.rule: a warm block is asked for as warm, so a meter can tell it apart (law AlternatesOrder).

mutants.name: bn2-meter-extra-sample
mutants.rule: Meter.ReadsEverySeries: one sample per series, no more (law Meter.ReadsEverySeries).

mutants.name: bn5-refused-value
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, Verdicts and refusals: a refused series prints no value (law RefusedHasNoValue).

mutants.name: bn5-digest-skipped
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, The receipt: a block whose digest a hand edit broke is refused (law EditIsRefused).

mutants.name: bn5-update-over-edit
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, The receipt: Update refuses to replace a block a hand edit broke (law EditIsRefused).

mutants.name: bn5-rounds-to-zero
mutants.rule: a nonzero value never prints as zero: its digits follow its interval's width (law NonzeroNeverPrintsZero).

mutants.name: bn5-home-path
mutants.from:
out = out[:at] + "~" + out[end:]
			at = strings.Index(out, prefix)
mutants.to:
out = out[:at] + "~" + out[at+len(prefix):]
			at = strings.Index(out, prefix) + 0*end
mutants.rule: specs/bench.md, The receipt: nothing published names a home path (law NoHomePath).

mutants.name: bn5-card-without-block
mutants.rule: a card names the block it comes from (id and digest) (law CardNamesItsBlock).

mutants.name: bn5-update-appends
mutants.rule: Update replaces the block of its id in place (law UpdateReplacesItsBlock).

mutants.name: bn5-proof-dropped
mutants.rule: every value the table prints has its pairs and its interval or exact (law NumberHasItsProof).

mutants.name: bn5-unscrubbed-json
mutants.rule: the receipt JSON names no home path (law NoHomePath).

mutants.name: bn5-schema-unchecked
mutants.rule: Decode refuses a receipt of another schema (law BlockRoundTrips).
